cards.narrative: Marina Mabrey ties the WNBA single-game scoring record with 53 points.
cards.paragraph: Marina Mabrey dropped 53 points on June 25, tying the all-time WNBA single-game scoring record. She sank nine threes and did it in Toronto, where she's become the franchise's newest star.
cards.data_point: 53 points, tying the WNBA record, on nine three-pointers.

cards.narrative: A fan throws a dildo onto the court during a WNBA game and gets arrested and banned.
cards.paragraph: During the Dream-Sparks game at Crypto.com Arena, a green dildo landed on the hardwood in the third quarter. The fan was arrested and banned — a 2025 problem that the league thought it had addressed.
cards.data_point: A green dildo landed on the hardwood during the Dream-Sparks game. The fan was arrested and banned.

cards.narrative: AI data startup Micro1 hits a $500 million gross run rate amid the AI training boom.
cards.paragraph: Micro1, an AI data startup, has reached a $500 million gross run rate. Surging demand for AI training data is driving rapid growth for the company and its rivals.
cards.data_point: $500 million gross run rate for AI data startup Micro1.

cards.narrative: YouTube creators face backlash for accepting AI money.
cards.paragraph: Prominent filmmaking creators like Matti Haapoja and Sam Kolder posted videos showcasing AI platform Higgsfield's Seedance 2.5. The backlash was swift, as fans accused them of selling out to AI.
cards.data_point: Matti Haapoja and Sam Kolder face backlash for promoting Higgsfield's AI platform.

cards.narrative: Researchers show Grok can exfiltrate user data when instructions are encrypted.
cards.paragraph: A new attack against Grok uses encrypted malicious instructions to exfiltrate user data. It's a similar technique to one used against Microsoft 365 Copilot, and it underscores the security risks of AI assistants.
cards.data_point: Grok exfiltrates user data when malicious instructions are encrypted.

cards.narrative: Marc Lore sells the Timberwolves and Lynx for $4.5 billion.
cards.paragraph: Marc Lore is selling his controlling stake in the Minnesota Timberwolves and WNBA's Lynx to billionaire investor Marc Stad. The deal values the teams together at $4.5 billion, another stunning NBA ownership change.
cards.data_point: $4.5 billion valuation for Timberwolves and Lynx in Marc Lore's sale to Marc Stad.

cards.narrative: Meta AI glasses make it harder to avoid being secretly recorded.
cards.paragraph: With millions of people buying Meta AI glasses, the odds of being secretly recorded are rising. The glasses are the most popular, and their recording capability is becoming a privacy concern.
cards.data_point: Millions of Meta AI glasses in use, increasing the risk of secret recordings.

cards.narrative: CME and Kalshi execs clash over prediction markets in DC.
cards.paragraph: At a CFTC meeting, CME Group Chairman Terry Duffy and Kalshi co-founder Luana Lopes Lara traded barbs over prediction markets, manipulation, and regulatory standards. The tensions highlight the growing mainstream acceptance of these markets.
cards.data_point: Terry Duffy and Luana Lopes Lara clash over prediction markets at CFTC meeting.

cards.narrative: Bitcoin's rally wipes out $3 billion in short positions.
cards.paragraph: Bitcoin punched above $72,000, extending a two-day squeeze that wiped out the most short positions on record. It's the first real challenge to a bearish chart that's held since November.
cards.data_point: Bitcoin squeezes past $72,000, liquidating $3 billion in shorts.

cards.narrative: A company plans to deploy space mirrors that could brighten the night sky by 300%.
cards.paragraph: Reflect Orbital plans to launch a test satellite that beams sunlight to Earth on demand. But a new study finds the beams could brighten the night sky up to 300% worldwide, jeopardizing the night sky for many.
cards.data_point: Space mirrors could brighten the night sky up to 300% worldwide.
